items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Johnny Dunn? Did you ever listen to Johnny Dunn? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: About 3 feet. It sounded like another trumpet, but it was just a novelty. Pappy(?) or Arthur Williams, he used to pick it up and blow a lot of solos on it. People said, 'Look at that.
